per_line.source_text: Do not stop at "test failed" or "CI pending." Diagnose/fix/retest within the current authorized work; only report a failure after beginning corrective action, with the practical cause, verified state and next blocker. Record interrupted or longer-running work in the issue/work journal and check actual CI/provider state before retries. Reuse passing evidence instead of rerunning expensive suites. Do not promise background execution that is not actually scheduled. Notify the owner when checks finish through available configured monitoring; the ChatGPT CI completion watch operates hourly (its maximum supported cadence), so it is not instantaneous. The owner should need only to name the issue. Keep concise updates: completed, verified, READY, blocked by a real constraint, and actually DEPLOYED. Do not publish on a development-only instruction.
